versos.texto_bv: Quanto ao povo que restou na terra de Judá, o qual Nabucodonosor, rei da Babilônia, havia deixado, ele colocou sobre eles Gedalias, filho de Aicão, filho de Safã.
versos.traducao_literal: E o povo restante na terra de Judá, que deixou Nabucodonosor, rei da Babilônia, colocou sobre eles Gedalias, filho de Aicão, filho de Safã.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): A reordenação para "colocou Gedalias sobre eles" (sem "como governador") mantém a sintaxe invertida pouco natural em pt-BR; a explicitação "como governador" (ARA/NVIPT) adiciona informação semântica não presente no original. — evidência: traducao_literal: "colocou sobre eles Gedalias" — sem menção a "governador". ARA adiciona "pôs por governador"; NTLH/NVIPT dizem "nomeou como governador". A BV não pode fazer a explicitação sem mudança de sentido; a sintaxe invertida é forma pouco natural mas fiel.

kjv.texto: And as for the people that remained in the land of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, ruler.

vizinhos.21: And the king of Babylon smote them, and slew them at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away out of their land.
vizinhos.23: And when all the captains of the armies, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, there came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan the son of Careah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.

web.texto: As for the people who were left in the land of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, governor.

vizinhos.21: The king of Babylon struck them, and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away captive out of his land.
vizinhos.23: Now when all the captains of the forces, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of the Maacathite, they and their men.
